entry.title: New: dsh-harness-ops
entry.summary: Self-healing DSH ops toolbox: official daily-snapshot A/B slot rotation (acceptance-gated atomic switch, one-click rollback), a 10s watchdog that auto-relaunches the web and resumes interrupted turns, and an out-of-band dsh-doctor (diagnosis → repair → relaunch) when web and agent are both down. Exact install spec: github:fakechris/dsh-harness-ops. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
